summary.text: Meghan Rosenfeld is the Democratic candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 34, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Republican and Independent Party of Connecticut candidate Melissa Ziobron in a race with no incumbent.
Ballotpedia lists an endorsement from the Connecticut AFL-CIO.
